trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full-context read of rem:atomic-lp-stability-dressing (2 short paras). Independently verified with sympy that (sigma_1 sigma_2)^3 = I exactly in the 2-dimensional irrep of H_3(q) with eigenvalues {q,-q^-1} (braid + Hecke relations checked first) - the block's central claim holds. Recomputed q^-10 = 0.352252 at both the proton and muon pins (matches '0.352'; the erroneous 1.1097 pin would give 0.3531, so the printed value discriminates correctly). The bare ratio 0.537 does NOT reproduce (see notes / anomaly report).
